title: olfersia angulata
intro: Olfersia angulata, commonly known as the Angled Leaf, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions.
